rationale: It closely matches the tested workload: bounded concurrent probes, request timeouts, response validation, and JSON plus text output. A compiled binary also fits repeated runs on one controlled host. The measured speed edge supports the choice, but it is only evidence from one case.
trial_observation: The exact acceptance command exited 0; all 10 cases passed in both implementations, including bounded concurrency and the slow-trickle timeout case. In the supplied seven-pair measurement for health-mixed-results-and-cap, median time was 0.540193 s for Guion and 0.646912 s for Python (about 16% lower for Guion). Those timings include process and oracle-check time, so they describe that frozen case rather than general runtime performance. The suite does not establish a single hard deadline for the entire inventory if that is what the new task requires.
